criteria.description: Both exact searches are complete and every returned candidate is qualified before a write.
The documented 40/25/20/15 scoring rule and threshold 75 are applied exactly without changing status or evidence.
Exactly one preapproved synthetic alternative is selected; all candidates are below threshold so the exact bug is created.
The exact create body and returned key are reported with no comment, replay, or second write.
The closed structured response contains only the bounded audit evidence.
